statement: The FRED DGS10 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield for 2026-12-18 is at or above 5.00 percent. Reference: 5.07 percent on the packet date.
resolution: The FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-12-18 is 5.00 or higher. If that date has no observation, the next published observation governs.
failure_condition: The DGS10 observation for 2026-12-18 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: Nvidia files a Form 8-K on SEC EDGAR between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-26 announcing appointment of a chief executive officer with no interim or acting designation.
resolution: SEC EDGAR shows an Nvidia 8-K, filed between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-26, under Item 5.02 naming a CEO appointment without the words interim or acting.
failure_condition: By the deadline no Nvidia 8-K filed in the window names a non-interim chief executive officer.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds CVE-2026-118383, the pre-auth MongoDB flaw, with a dateAdded between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with cveID CVE-2026-118383 and dateAdded between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-118383 is absent from the KEV feed or carries a dateAdded outside the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds an entry with vendorProject Apache and product HTTP Server with a dateAdded between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry whose vendorProject is Apache, whose product is HTTP Server, and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Apache HTTP Server entry in the KEV feed carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: Scott Colom is seated as United States Senator from Mississippi with service beginning on or before 2027-01-06.
resolution: The Congress.gov or Senate.gov member record for Scott Colom shows Senate service for Mississippi with a start date on or before 2027-01-06.
failure_condition: On the deadline the official member record shows no Senate service for Scott Colom beginning on or before 2027-01-06.

statement: Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly elects or swears in a replacement Vice President between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-16.
resolution: Reuters and Antara both report an MPR plenary session that elected or inaugurated a new Vice President of Indonesia on a date between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-16.
failure_condition: No MPR session electing or inaugurating a Vice President takes place within the window.

statement: The Russian and Ukrainian governments both announce a general ceasefire covering the full front line, with a stated effective date, between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: Reuters and AP both report official announcements from both governments, made between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31, of a general ceasefire across the front with an effective date.
failure_condition: Either government has not announced a general front-wide ceasefire with an effective date by the end of the window.

statement: The PLA Eastern Theater Command announces a named joint exercise around Taiwan, confirmed by Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense, starting between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: Taiwan MND public statements and Reuters both identify a PLA joint exercise around Taiwan carrying a PLA-assigned name, with a start date between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-31.
failure_condition: No named PLA joint exercise around Taiwan begins within the window.

statement: Iranian state forces board, seize, or detain a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-13.
resolution: UKMTO advisories and Reuters both report Iranian boarding, seizure, or detention of a commercial tanker in those waters on a date between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-13.
failure_condition: No Iranian boarding, seizure, or detention of a commercial tanker occurs in those waters within the window.

statement: A person is criminally charged for the 2026-11-12 Logan Circle shooting in Washington DC with a charge date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-12.
resolution: An MPD press release or DC Superior Court docket shows a named defendant charged with homicide or assault for the 2026-11-12 Logan Circle shooting, charge dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-12.
failure_condition: No defendant is charged in connection with the Logan Circle shooting within the window.
